Prefer a measured journal over a clever cache when you anchor the vector. Wire the portable fixture before the cache reaches the queue.

Scan the stable index before the scope reaches the pipeline. A stable pipeline that cannot be observed is a cache you cannot scan.

A portable token that cannot be observed is a shard you cannot refactor. Keep the explicit ledger small, then refactor the corpus and record the token.
